gis facere noluerit testamentum, sed epistolis,
aut quibuscunque aliis rebus seruis suis pluri-
bus quam per testamentum licet, conferre vo-
luerit libertates, & sub tempore mortis hoc fe-
cerit, hii qui prius manumissi fuerunt, vsque ad
numerum superius constitutum, liberi erunt.
Qui vero post statutum numerum manumissi
fuerint, serui sine dubio permanebunt: nam si
incolumis quoscunque diuerso rempore ma-
numisit, inter eos qui per testamentum manu-
missi sunt, nullatenus computentur.

page.notes: Printed page is faint in places. The final line "de" at right is the catchword. The footer line "Sed & hoc statutum est, vt" is a repetition of the last line of text and is not a separate printed note; it is included only in error and should be disregarded. The Google watermark is excluded. Uncertain readings: "quàtafamilia" and "quintam" may be misreadings of printed forms.
